caption: The switch on a rotating shop display stand is pressed, and the stand begins to turn with its lights on.

sa.check: A rotating shop display stand with a switch.
Its lights are on as it turns.
The stand is still and dark before the press.
The order is still, press, turning and lit.

pc.expect: The stand starts to turn and its lights come on together at the press, and only then.
pc.fail: The switch is pressed and the stand stays still to the end of the clip; or the stand turns before the press; or the lights come on while the stand stays still to the end; or the stand turns while its lights stay dark to the end.

pc.expect: Before the press nothing on the stand moves; afterwards it turns steadily and does not stop, start or reverse on its own; the items on it ride round with it.
pc.fail: The stand stops and restarts with the switch untouched; or reverses; or items on the stand stay fixed while the stand turns beneath them; or items slide off with the stand turning slowly.

pc.expect: The stand turns about its own upright axis; items on it keep their places relative to each other.
pc.fail: The stand wobbles off its axis; or moves across the floor; or items swap places as it turns; or the top turns while the base turns the other way.

pc.expect: Once on, the lights stay lit and the stand keeps turning while the switch stays on.
pc.fail: The lights go out again with the switch on; or flicker; or the switch presses itself again; or the stand slows to a stop with the switch on.

pc.expect: One stand with its items; the items keep their number and pass through nothing; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: Items on the stand appear or vanish as it turns; or an item sinks into the shelf; or the stand duplicates; or the hand passes into the stand.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The stand's colour and the items' colours stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The stand changes colour; or an item changes colour or shape; or the shop background rearranges.
